en: Just a humble taxi driver. My license is my only redeeming feature, remember?
Aaagh!
(I've wasted time and come out of it with no pay. There must have been a better way to handle this.)
We give up!
We'll pay you your money! I promise we'll never look down on a driver again!
How the hell did you get that strong, man? Who are you!?
All right, I'm out. What now?
Well, we could call your company up and complain, but that wouldn't improve the service. So we'll just give you a few educational pointers ourselves!
Heheh. I'm in a bad mood today, so this'll be good stress relief!
I see. Sorry, but I've about had enough of you two.
Ha! Now he's talking down to us! Looks like he wants a few extra lessons!
There's nothing you can teach me.
Yeah? I guess you're right.
No matter how much a driver's taught, their license is their only redeemin' feature.
(I can't let that remark go unpunished.)
You'd better take that back.
Hehe! Make me, asshole!
Time to settle the fare.
Ah, looks like I'm out of change right now. Just round it down to the nearest thousand yen, will ya?
I have change.
What's wrong with you? Times like this, you're supposed to round down as part of the service!
I may do that for long-distance fares, but not in this case.
What!? You telling us we're not customers just because you only took us a few blocks?
That's not what I said. If I round down to the nearest thousand, I'll hardly make anything.
Grr! This guy doesn't seem to think we're worthy of his attention!
Well if he won't serve us, why pay?
Yeah, let's bounce outta this shithole!
What? You got a problem? You better not get too cocky, taxi driver. Or do ya want to go toe-to-toe with us?
There's an idea! Let's rough him up a little! It'll be some real good stress relief!
I'm from Nagasu Taxi. Sorry for the wait. Where are you headed?
Just start driving! Hurry!
(Sounds like she's in trouble.)
I need you to get me away from here, fast.
Phew, I don't think they've seen me yet.
Is someone looking for you?
Yes, the royal security detail. They are no doubt searching far and wide for me as we speak.
Royal?
Yes. I'm a princess, from the Kingdom of Coutand.
Oh, don't look so nervous. I may be royalty, but I'm just flesh and blood like you.
(Is she delusional? Or is this some kind of joke? I guess I'll dig a little deeper.)
Where is the Kingdom of Coutand?
Hm. I guess it's only natural you don't know of it.
Coutand is a very small island nation, far to the southwest of Hakata Bay.
You look and sound Japanese to me.
Yes, people of Coutand look practically identical to the Japanese. We must share a common ancestor.
But, as a result, we have a very good relationship with Japan and many of us study the language. That's why I am fluent in Japanese.
No kidding.
So, what's a princess doing in Fukuoka?
I came with my father, the king.
He didn't want to impose on the Japanese government by making it an official visit, so we came unannounced.
(She's got quite the imagination. I guess I'll press a little further.)
(Wow, it's almost as if she believes this is all true. I'll ask one more thing.)
(She's playing this pretty straight. I'm not sure what to say. She does looks pretty serious.)
By the way, miss⑬
Hey! I'm all for mingling with the common folk, but you need to watch how you address me. You're still talking to a princess.
Right... Sorry, Your Royal Highness. Where would you like me to take you?
My security detail may still be searching for me. Just keep driving so they don't find me.
Why are you running away from your own security?
The other day the king decided it was time for me to marry, and he picked my husband-to-be.
But I did not like the man he selected at all. My father, however, refuses to give me any say in it.
I cannot bear the thought of a life where I must spend the rest of my days with someone I do not love. So, I decided to run away.
I chose Japan because nobody knows me here. I thought it would be the perfect place to start a new life.
I see. And now your security detail is out looking for you, huh?
That's right. And their driving skills are quite formidable. If they find me, I doubt we'd be able to get away.
(I'm getting a little tired of playing along with this fantasy. I'll just smile and nod.)
My security detail caught up with us!
Well, what are you waiting for!? If they spot us, you'll be punished, too, you know!
Hm. That would be a shame.
Argh! How can you be so complacent!? Look at the car behind us!
That's my security detail! If they catch up, it'll all be over!
Mmhm. Right.
(Wait, there is a suspicious-looking car behind us. And it's coming up fast!)
(They're definitely following this taxi. Don't tell me her stories were all true...)
Hurry up! Don't let them catch us!
We must have lost them now.
There's that taxi!
Did they find us!? Oh no! Let's go!
Fine. I just want to get this over with.
It looks like we've lost them. Thank you, driver. I am sorry I dragged you into all this.
Who exactly are you?
Like I said, I am a princess of the Kingdom of Coutand.
Yes, I heard you.
So was there something else you wanted to know?
No... I guess not.
Well, we've taken care of my security team. Now I'll have to find a place to hide. Thank you for getting me this far. I appreciate it.
Here is the money for the ride.
I must be going. I trust that you won't mention you saw me to anyone else.
Good. I am glad I ended up with you. Farewell.
Take care... Your Royal Highness.
They caught up with us... It's over.
Who are you guys? I'm trying to do my job here.
We're security for the Kingdom of Coutand.
(She was telling the truth?)
And we're taking you into custody for kidnapping our princess!
Stop! He's done nothing wrong!
Please, Your Royal Highness. We're just doing our job.
Now, get that driver! And I don't care if you have to knock him around to do it!
Phew, thank you! Your driving skills really are amazing!
Well, we've shaken off my security team. Now I'll have to find a place to hide. Thank you for getting me this far⑬I appreciate it.
So, who exactly were those guys?
Hm? Like I said before, I am a princess of the Kingdom of Coutand, so⑬
Yes, I heard you the first time.
Then was there something else you wanted to know?
...No, never mind. Anyway, is that all?
Yes. Here is money for the ride, along with a reward.
(That's a huge tip. Maybe she really is who she says.)
I am glad I met you. If only the man my father wanted me to marry was as gallant as you.
Sorry? Did you say something?
Oh, it's nothing. Farewell!
(Farewell, Princess.)
Woo-hoo-hoo! Thanks, dude! This race'll be the talk of the town! And I'mma make a killing off of it!
You haven't forgotten our terms, have you?
Yeah, yeah. If you win, I disband the Devil Killers. But don't worry. No way in hell you're gonna win!
Ahahahahaha!
Who you bettin' on today?
Devil Takamura, duh.
Yeah. I heard rumors about that taxi driver being good, but no way in hell he's beating Takamura.
In all honesty... I kinda want him to win. The cabbie, I mean.
Yeah, those Devil Killers have been outta control for way too long. They're a pain in the ass to everyone, racers included.
Shh! There he is.
So, you're Suzuki, I presume?
Yeah. And you're Devil Takamura, I take it?
The one and only.
All right then. Just so we're clear, you'll disband your group if I win?
Whoa, hey, relax. We still have time in the limelight⑬gotta appreciate that, y'know?
I mean, look around. Street racers from all over Japan are hanging on our every movement. They're even streaming us online.
Bet it's not often a taxi driver like you gets his fifteen minutes of fame, huh?
...I bet there's a lot of money riding on this. Am I right?
Heh. So what if there is?
Don't you have any respect for your founder?
Hahaha! You talking about that Nakajima guy? Who cares about that old has-been? He's all washed up now!
I mean, working to save money to fix up your car? Racing solely to improve your <Italic>time</Italic>? Sounds like shit my grandpa'd say!
As you can see, I ain't new to this game. Because of my genius, this street racing shit is our cash cow. Guess it doesn't hurt to have the Devil Killers' image, though.
And people respect that image because of how hard the founders worked to build it. And this is how you repay them?

Fuck yeah, dude! As long as the Devil Killers keep raking in
the money, what's the problem? You really need to keep up
with the times, man! Ahahahahaha!
(This guy doesn't know a thing.)
But for real, don't worry. Everyone knows the Devil Killers are still the most badass team from way back when. That part ain't gonna change.
Well, at least until I've milked the Devil Killers' image for all it's worth. Then hey, who knows? Maybe I'll start something new. Sky's the limit, y'know?

And hey, these shitheads should be honored an entrepreneur
like me is doing them all a favor! Ahahahahaha!
I won't let you throw all those dreams away.

Oh, and what's a cabbie gonna do? You think I got to where
I am just by talking big?
Lemme tell you, buddy⑬point blank⑬I earned my spot as fifth leader of the Devil Killers by being the fastest fuckin' driver. Period.
Now let's get this show on the road! Gotta give the audience what they came for, right!?
Yo! We're getting our asses out of here!
You'll get yours soon enough, man! I'll make sure of it!
Hold up.
What a pitiful sight... Never thought the "legendary" Devil Killers could sink so low. You oughta be ashamed.
Hey, isn't that...?
Seriously, you don't know!? That guy's like the biggest name in racing here in Fukuoka.
Onisaka-san!?
(Who's this character all of a sudden?)
Shoot, I... I didn't know you were gonna be here!
You start acting up on this scale, word is gonna reach me.
Uh, well, you see⑬this is all the taxi driver's fault! He picked a fight with us. So we, uh...
Don't even bother. I've been doing my own research.
I heard you were throwing your weight around. And I only gave you a pass because you had clout with the community. But now that's all ancient history.
Yeah? What's your point?
My point? Do I really need to restate how bad this taxi driver beat you to a pulp?
He's top dog now, so abiding by our rules... I'm ordering you to break up the Devil Killers!
But that would mean...

The Devil Killers are pretty much done for at this point!
What with Onisaka-san giving the order...
One man really has that kinda pull?
Of course he does! He's pretty much the law in racing circles.
Your team is hereby disbanded, never to use the Devil Killers name again. Any objections?
Then get your ass off the road.
...You heard the man!
So you're Suzuki, huh? I'm Onisaka. I look after the young guns around here.
Thanks for intervening.
No need to thank me. You're the one who beat Takamura. That's all I needed to see.
But without you, they wouldn't have honored the agreement. So I appreciate you showing up.
Slow down there, pal. You don't think I came all this way just to help you get rid of a few punks, do you?
Why, then?
Well... You work for Nakajima, right?
Yeah... I do.
Then I'm assuming he wanted you to race the Devil Killers into submission, huh? Break 'em up that way?
Ultimately, yes.
Mm-hm. Yeah, that ain't gonna fly with me.
Because he's a coward. People who chicken out of a challenge have no say in racing matters.
Twenty years ago, the two of us were rivals. Nakajima, the undisputed champion... and me, the runner-up.
No matter how many times I raced him, he always won out in the end. I lost to him countless times.
Then one day, I decided enough was enough. I took a year off to travel the country, taking on as many other racers as I could.
Before I left, I made Nakajima swear not to lose to anyone. That way I'd still be taking on Fukuoka's best when I got back.
But when I returned, I found out he'd vanished from the streets. Gone, just like that. Promises be damned.
It demoralized me, Suzuki-san. An entire year completely down the drain, with no explanation whatsoever.
All that time, with nobody to race? What a fucking way to leave an old friend behind...
I'm sure Nakajima-san had his reasons. He's not the kind of guy to break his word.
You think I don't know that!? *sigh* ...I know he must have some kind of situation.
But that still doesn't keep me from wanting that race. He owes me.
